patch_description: This uses a memetic spherical-code search rather than direct optimization of arbitrary 14-point coordinates. The 14 points are represented as the positive and negative endpoints of seven optimized unoriented lines. This fixes the diameter while reducing the problem to minimizing the largest absolute inner product between line directions. A batched evolutionary population periodically reseeds poor candidates from elite line codes, followed by sharp projected contact-force relaxation and exact-coherence stochastic polishing.
